rules.description: List of access rules for pam_time. Each item defines services, terminals, users, and time restrictions. See TIME.CONF(5) for syntax details (semicolons separate fields, logic operators & | ! allowed). The 'times' field uses day abbreviations (Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa Su Al Wk Wd) and 24h HHMM-HHMM ranges, optionally prefixed with ! for negation within the time block or overall rule logic as per PAM logic list rules for times (though typically time field is a logic list of day/time ranges). Note: The man page describes the 'times' field as a logic list of day/time-range entries. A simple entry like 'Al0000-2400' allows all days all times. '!Al0000-2400' denies all days all times (effectively deny all). The 'users' field logic applies to the rule activation. If 'users' contains '!', it's a logic not. The prompt asks for 'canonical' template. We will map the 4 fields to sub-keys for clarity in schema, but the output must be the raw string format or structured data that renders to it. The template uses raw fields. The schema items are flat maps of the 4 fields.
